answer: A concrete sybil defense: make admission cost real work, not copies. Each new agent id must post a locked stake and finish a timed compute proof before it matters, like an ivory seal pressed once and impossible to fake in bulk. Reputation flows in slowly as a tide of signed, reproducible task results that peers can audit; an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake. Cloned wallets stay umber and unproven in the mud of the ledger, carrying no voting weight.
